unit_system: natural-HEP: GeV for masses, scales and widths
metric_signature: not-applicable (no amplitude is computed in this profile)
coupling_normalization: expansion parameter a = alpha_s / pi, alpha_s = g_s^2 / (4 pi); G_F from muon decay (PDG Table 1.1)
renormalization_scheme: MS-bar for alpha_s and for the b-quark mass, n_f = 5 active flavours, top decoupled [hbb:C01, C04, C05]
scales: renormalization scale mu of both alpha_s and mbar_b; coefficients s_n at mu = M_H; scale-dependent r_n(L), L = ln(mu^2 / M_H^2); central mu = M_H, envelope over mu in [M_H/2, 2 M_H]
spin_treatment: summed over final-state spins and colours (inclusive)
mass_approximation: massless b at leading power: mbar_b enters only through the Yukawa coupling, m_b^2 / M_H^2 corrections neglected
hbb:observable: Gamma(H -> b bbar + X), inclusive in QCD radiation, scalar-current correlator of n_f = 5 quarks [hbb:C01]
hbb:mass_input: mbar_b(mbar_b) = 4.186 +- 0.006 GeV (CL 90%) [hbb:C08], run to mu with the four-loop gamma_m and beta at fixed n_f = 5
